Let \(d_n=a_n-a_{n-1}\). Since  
\[
a_n=\frac{a_{n-1}+a_{n-2}}2,
\]
we get
\[
d_n=a_n-a_{n-1}=-\frac{a_{n-1}-a_{n-2}}2=-\frac{d_{n-1}}2.
\]
Also \(d_2=85-105=-20\). Hence for \(k\ge2\),
\[
d_k=-20\left(-\frac12\right)^{k-2}.
\]
Thus
\[
a_n=a_1+\sum_{k=2}^n d_k
=105-20\sum_{j=0}^{n-2}\left(-\frac12\right)^j.
\]
For \(n=2011\),
\[
a_{2011}=105-20\cdot \frac{1-\left(-\frac12\right)^{2010}}{1+\frac12}
=105-\frac{40}{3}\left(1-2^{-2010}\right)
=\frac{275}{3}+\frac{40}{3}\cdot 2^{-2010}.
\]
Since this is \(91+\frac23+\text{tiny}\), its integer part is \(91\).

\[
\boxed{91}
\]
